description: Retrieve one published book by its catalog ID, obtained from search_books or a related record. Returns exactly the public REST detail fields, publication-filtered relationships and public page/media links. Unpublished and unknown IDs both return not found. Books include categories, publisher-maintained overall availability and purchase_destinations with retailer, URL, marketplace/region and known edition; verified Amazon.com destinations come first without changing book ranking. Unknown edition/availability must not be guessed; no live stock is supplied. Book content is catalog metadata and deliberately public sample links only.
name: get_book
